title: SeVerus: Context-Aware, Gamified Benchmarking for Rust Verification
abstract: arXiv:2611.07194v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents achieve high success rates on existing benchmarks for Verus, a verifier for Rust programs. These benchmarks typically provide the auxiliary lemmas needed to complete a proof. In practice, however, such lemmas must be discovered and proved. To capture this challenge, we present SEVERUS, a context-aware technique to generate Verus benchmarks that organizes verification tasks into quests, each divided into levelsin a gamified manner. Using the original proof dependencies in verified projects, SEVERUS constructs one quest per verification target and progressively removes proof context to create individual levels. These levels range from the easiest, requiring completing only a single missing lemma, to the hardest, requiring proving the target without any supporting lemmas. translated_title: SeVerus：面向 Rust 程序验证的上下文感知、游戏化基准测试
translated_abstract: 编码智能体在 Verus（一种 Rust 程序验证器）的现有基准测试上取得了很高的成功率。这些基准测试通常直接提供完成证明所需的辅助引理。然而在实践中，这类引理必须被发现并加以证明。为了刻画这一挑战，我们提出了 SEVERUS，这是一种上下文感知的 Verus 基准测试生成技术，它以游戏化的方式将验证任务组织成任务链，每条任务链又被划分为不同难度级别。利用已验证项目中原始的证明依赖关系，SEVERUS 为每个验证目标构建一条任务链，并通过逐步移除证明上下文来创建各个级别。这些级别从最简单的（只需补全单个缺失引理）到最困难的（需要在没有任何辅助引理的情况下证明目标）。一个独立的检查器会拒绝对可执行代码的修改、被削弱的规范以及不健全的证明构造。一种带噪声的二分搜索方法用于估计……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出 SeVerus，一种上下文感知、游戏化的 Verus 基准测试生成技术，它利用已验证项目的原始证明依赖关系，通过逐步移除证明上下文将验证任务组织成从易到难的任务链，从而更真实地评估编码智能体自主发现并证明辅助引理的能力。
en_tdlr: SeVerus is a context-aware, gamified benchmark generation technique for Verus that organizes verification tasks into quests of progressive difficulty by progressively removing proof context, thereby more realistically assessing coding agents' ability to discover and prove auxiliary lemmas on their own.
